subject: Cloudway pilot decision window and procurement next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben O'Connor <ben.oconnor@cloudway.io>, procurement@cloudway.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cloudway pilot decision window and procurement next steps

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum heading into the close of Q4: 

Call highlights:
- Primary goal: validate inference latency and cost at 500 concurrent sessions for Cloudway Search pilot
- Privacy: data stays in your VPC; Redwood Private + KMS integration required for audit controls
- Success metrics: P95 latency < 400ms, token cost <$0.003 per 1k tokens, integration readiness in 4 weeks

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Procurement: confirm preferred contract vehicle (PO vs. SOW) and any required terms (NDA already complete)
2) Technical: we offered a short pilot package — we'll deliver a dedicated endpoint for 4 weeks for evaluation
3) Pricing: attached is a simple pilot SOW + one-page discovery summary for internal review (Attachment: Redwood-Discovery-Summary.pdf)

Can you confirm whether procurement has a target approval date? We know many teams freeze approvals in the last week of the quarter — are you trying to close this before the calendar quarter ends, or should we plan for an early-January sign-off?

I'll follow up in a few days if I don't hear back. If it's helpful, I can loop in our Head of Sales (Marissa) or Solutions Engineering for a short procurement review call.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: Redwood-Discovery-Summary.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@cloudway.io
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloudway pilot decision window and procurement next steps

Hi Ben —

Bumping this in case it got buried as you head into the holiday cadence. Two quick points: 
- The pilot SOW I attached is intentionally simple (4-week dedicated endpoint + success criteria).
- We can compress start dates if procurement gives an early OK this week.

If you're still on the fence about timing, a short 15-minute calibration with Marissa + your procurement lead can speed alignment. Happy to set that up — what days/times work next week?

Best,
Hannah

Cc: procurement@cloudway.io
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloudway pilot decision window and procurement next steps

Hi Hannah —

Apologies for the slow reply — been a bit heads-down as folks close IP for the quarter. We're generally aligned on the pilot scope, but legal and procurement want to re-run a quick review of the SOW and data handling clauses.

Short answers: 
- Interest: yes, still interested.
- Timing: procurement expects to have paperwork back to us by end of next week (week of 12/28) — so likely early Jan for signatures.
- Ask: can you provide a cleaned SOW with explicit KMS/HSM language and the pricing line items separated (pilot vs. potential production commit)?

If you can send an updated SOW, I'll fast-track it to procurement.

Thanks —
Ben O'Connor
Director of Product | Cloudway
ben.oconnor@cloudway.io
Attachment: (none)

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Quick check — budget & approval runway before holidays?

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the update — appreciate you flagging procurement/legal. Quick check as we approach the holidays: is the budget and approval still expected to move in the early-Jan window you mentioned, or should we plan to re-engage mid-Jan instead?

We want to avoid scheduling engineering work over the holidays if the decision will slip; conversely, if you still expect a sign-off early next week, we can prioritize a compressed onboarding and reserve a small pilot bucket so you start immediately.

I'm attaching an updated SOW with the KMS language and separated pricing lines — happy to redline further if your procurement team prefers edits inline.

Attachment: SOW-draft-v1.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)

If helpful, Marissa and I can join a 20-minute call with procurement early next week to resolve the KMS wording and get a PO template. Would Tuesday 12/29 at 11am PT work for you?

Best wishes for the holidays either way —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
